text:
maria: quick sync — DP asks keep expanding during sprints. want to lock a lightweight intake + clear go/no-go gates to avoid surprise scope.
jin: agree. propose three paths: "light" (config/UX tweak), "standard" (new API surface or small infra), "heavy" (new infra, data onboarding, SLA). each path has required artifacts.
ravi: can we make the routing deterministic? intake form outputs a numeric risk score and a path enum. then PD/Engineering can fast decide.
elaine: yep. minimal artifacts per path: light -> owner + sample prompts + smoke test; standard -> spec doc + cost estimate + 1 test customer; heavy -> full rollout plan, SLA ask, security checklist.
ops-bot: rule: any request that sets data_residency != "cloud" or mentions "on-prem" auto-tags security.
jin: scoring sketch (pseudo):
```
score = 0
if data_sensitivity == 'high': score += 4
if infra_changes == 'yes': score += 3
if qps_expected >= 100: score += 2
if customer_type == 'enterprise': score += 1
# 0-2 -> light, 3-5 -> standard, 6+ -> heavy
```
maria: nice. also include an "eng effort estimate" field (t-shirt small/med/large) so PMs have context.
elaine: launch gates per path (short):
- light: PR + smoke test on staging, docs update, PD sign-off
- standard: all light plus perf test p95 target, cost/capacity calc, 1 pilot customer
- heavy: all standard plus SLA paper, infra runbook, legal/data MOU if customer data used
ravi: success metrics to tie to launch: usage growth (qps), latency p95, cost per 1k tokens, and a qualitative CSAT from DP after 2 weeks. default post-launch eval at 14 and 60 days.
jin: feedback loop: schedule 2 structured feedback sessions during beta (week 1 and week 4). require partners to opt-in to sharing annotated prompts (or decline). if decline -> deprioritize for deeper integrations.
elaine: monitoring: add sampling of prompts (2%), automated quality regressions (drop in human pass rate >10%), and token cost alert if cost/1k increases +20% vs baseline.
maria: intake template (short):
```
Hi {contact},
Thanks for partnering with us on {feature}. Quick ask: company, contact email, short problem statement, expected peak qps, data residency, sample prompts (if ok), desired path (light/standard/heavy). We'll triage within 48h.
```
ravi: include a checkbox: "willing to run short A/B or provide labeled examples". that improves evals.
legal-bot: reminder: heavy path requests touching customer data require a preliminary DPA/MOU conversation before pilot.
ops-bot: automation items: (1) scoring lambda attached to form, (2) auto-tag rules for security/legal, (3) webhook to create ticket in PD tracker with score + path.\jin: owners: maria -> intake wording + runbook, ravi -> scoring lambda, elaine -> launch gate checklist + dashboards, legal-bot -> DPA triggers. timeline: MVP in 8 business days?
maria: ambitious but doable if scope is just form + lambda + one-page runbook. set expectation to pilot internally with 2 teams before wide DP outreach.
ravi: i'll spin the lambda and mock tickets this week. can we get an ops-bot reminder to review on 7th business day?
ops-bot: reminder set for 7 business days in #product.
elaine: i'll draft dashboard widgets (latency p95, cost/1k, DP CSAT) and post the mockups.
maria: great. goal: cut mid-sprint scope creep by 50% and make DP asks predictable. check-in Fri for progress.
jin: +1, thanks team.
